summary: Turkcell Iletisim Hizmetleri A.S. filed a Form 6-K disclosing a signed Share Purchase Agreement, dated November 2, 2026, to acquire 796,567,640 shares of Turkiye'nin Otomobili Girisim Grubu (TOGG) from AG Anadolu Grubu Holding A.S., representing 11% of TOGG's share capital, for EUR 88,000,000 in cash payable at closing. Board approval occurred November 2, 2026, with majority independent directors consenting; no valuation report was prepared as not legally required. Post-closing Turkcell's TOGG stake and voting rights rise to 34.0%. Closing awaits regulatory approvals and conditions precedent; no takeover-bid obligation arose. Watch regulatory clearance timing and any follow-on stake moves.
